messages:
anika: Heads-up: hitting a reproducible parse failure in node samplekit when a tool/fncall retries mid-stream.
anika: Scenario: jsonMode=true, transport emits frame, auth 401 -> retry, transport replays buffered frame. Assembly returns an array, validator expects an object.

anika: Minimal repro: call client.callTool(..., {jsonMode: true}), force a token refresh during stream, then validateSchema(resp) -> throws.
sanjay: Which SDK version?
anika: node-sdk@1.10.3 (samplekit). Python behaves differently and returns an object in this flow.
priya: Sounds like stream assembly treats multiple frames as "array" and doesn't collapse single-element arrays after retry. Parity gap.
sanjay: Quick mitigation: collapse single-element arrays into object at jsonMode boundary when expected schema is OBJECT. Also add strictJsonMode to reject coercion.
priya: I'll add a unit test that mocks retransmitted frames and a parity harness comparing node/python. Also adding an assembly debug flag so support can capture frame sequences without full traces.
anika: Please also note this in the onboarding guide (node sample flagged) until fixed; a customer demo hit this.
devex-bot: Created ticket DX-1220: "node samplekit: chunk replay -> array vs object in jsonMode" (labels: dx, parity, onboarding, hotfix).
sanjay: I'll prepare a tiny hotfix PR to normalize assembly and include changelog + tests.
anika: Thanks, attaching a tiny repro (recorded frames + harness) to DX-1220. :thumbsup:
